title: physalastrum flavescens
intro: Physalastrum flavescens, commonly known as the golden slime mold, is a species of fungus that belongs to the phylum Plasmodiophoromycota. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Physalastrum flavescens include wound healing, antifungal activity, and the inhibition of cancer cell growth.
